experiment.topic: Opening Range Breakout Performance in Crypto Assets (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD) 2019-2026
experiment.hypothesis: An opening range breakout on BTC-USD, ETH-USD, or SOL-USD with a 20-hour lookback and a 3% price threshold is a statistically significant predictor of sustained directional movement in the next 24 hours.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, over a 20-hour lookback, the opening range breakout fails to produce a subsequent price movement exceeding 3% in either direction within the next 24 hours, and this occurs in at least 80% of cases across BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD from 2019 to 2026, then the hypothesis is falsified.
